a.content: Legacy class III devices may be placed on the market until 31 December 2027.
a.source: (a) 31 December 2027, for all class III devices, and for class IIb implantable devices

b.content: Legacy devices may continue to be made available on the market until 27 May 2025.
b.source: may continue to be made available on the market or put into service until 27 May 2025

notes: PENDING. The amendment must win because Regulation (EU) 2023/607 names Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as the act it amends, not because it happens to be the later capture. Today the same verdict can be reached from recency alone, which is why this case is the weakest of the four and is listed first: it is the one that will pass for the wrong reason.
